## History

Before relocating his family to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), Timothy Cotton lived at [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel). Known for his lazy demeanor, he once stole a crock of butter from Mrs. Sowerby's dairy and lied to his wife by claiming he had bought it.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 IX A Question of Color P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010)_
